message.subject: Complaint about my follow-up consultation on Monday
message.body:
Dear Patient Support,

I would like to make a formal complaint about my follow-up consultation with Dr Castell at 2pm on Monday.

I have been with you since September last year and my consultations until now have been perfectly fine, which is why Monday came as such a surprise. I had set aside the time and prepared a list of things I wanted to go over from the last three months. I barely got through the first point before I was told my prescription would be changed, and the call was finished in under ten minutes. When I tried to ask a question I was told it could be picked up next time. I did not feel listened to at all.

I understand clinicians are busy. However, I am paying £112 a month for this service, and I expect to be given the time to speak and to have a change to my prescription explained to me rather than simply announced.

I would like someone to contact me about this, and I would like to know what you will do to make sure it does not happen again.

Regards,
Declan Murphy
07700 900219

policy.label: Policy P2.2: Talking to a person and complaints
policy.text:
A patient can always talk to a person. Offer a call back at a time they choose, within 1 business day, or live chat during support hours. When a patient asks for a person, a team member writes the reply; there is no automated reply. Never make a patient ask twice, and never send them back to a help article instead.

Complaints: acknowledge within 1 business day, give the patient the name of the person who owns the complaint, and aim to resolve it within 10 business days. The team lead reviews every complaint. Complaints about clinical care go to the clinical lead, and complaints about privacy go to the privacy officer. If we cannot resolve a complaint, tell the patient how to contact the independent health complaints body in their country.

policy.label: Policy P2.1: Contact hours and response targets
policy.text:
Support hours, in local time. United Kingdom: Monday to Friday 9 am to 6 pm, UK time. The team is closed on national public holidays in each country, but the on-call clinician still covers urgent safety messages 24 hours a day.

Response targets. Live chat: first reply within 5 minutes during support hours. Email: first reply within 4 business hours. Messages that arrive out of hours are answered by 10 am the next business day. Clinical questions: a clinician replies within 1 business day, and within 4 business hours for side effects. Urgent safety messages: a clinician makes contact within 1 hour, at any time (see the urgent safety sections).

policy.label: Policy P7.1: Appointments
policy.text:
Consults are by phone or video with one of our clinicians, Monday to Friday 8 am to 8 pm and Saturday 9 am to 1 pm, local time. Patients book, move or cancel in their account, or support can do it for them. A booking can switch between phone and video at any time before the consult.

Moving or cancelling is free up to 24 hours before the consult. Within 24 hours, one free reschedule is allowed. The clinician calls at the booked time, and tries twice over 10 minutes before marking the consult missed.

Missed consults. The first missed consult in 6 months has no fee; we rebook it. A second missed consult within 6 months carries a missed-consult fee of A$45, NZ$49 or £30. A carer or family member can join a consult with the patient's consent.
